title: Spiced Turkish Turkey Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful and aromatic stir-fry dish with juicy turkey, served with a side of steamed vegetables.

ingredients.name: Turkish Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, paprika, and coriander

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced turkey breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the spiced stir-fry sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
